limitations: One source seed20262020 and previously viewed Industrial/RF100 development populations; no fresh blind test or significance claim.
Fixed C4 semantic mean pooling with this source training budget failed to fit source scalar readings; this does not establish failure of every C4-invariant method.
CNN training views match v16; original presentations, optimizer attempts, correlated BN views, photometric draws and checkpoint choices differ. Equal views do not imply equal compute.

Invalid saved scalar predictions are null and retain error1 once per original; finite saturated predictions can also have error1. The saved CSV does not distinguish NaN, infinity or other rejected raw scalar causes.
Initialization and source-only BN behavior reuse saved preflight/code metadata; this CPU audit loads no weights, decodes no RGB and runs no CNN, backward pass, old GT or tests.
The fixed0.5 constant is descriptive and unfitted. No target mean/median, angle, threshold, temperature, precision or checkpoint was fitted or selected.
Historical endpoint/old GeoPRR comparisons reuse already aligned v16 metrics; historical executed pixels and weight provenance are not recertified.
